content.text: Picked the GTA VI trophy rarity forecast (gta6-trophy-rarity-forecast-01) as the solo-winnable entry: a closed-form prior workhorse, a 7-day runway, and a clear beat-the-house-baseline prize bar. First I need the exact case and output format from the kit before writing anything.

content.content: case: JSON {schema, id, at, horizon_minutes, target, levels, game, trophies[], history[]}; output: {"trophies": [{"id": n, "q": [q05,q25,q50,q75,q95]}]} in percent, levels 0.05/0.25/0.5/0.75/0.95; scoring: mean pinball loss on the logit scale, lower is better; the house baseline is persistence + a 0.5*sqrt(days) random walk, and it scored about 1.51 on practice

content.text: Format is clear and my first draft was wrong about it, so it comes out. The real structure is trophies[] plus history[] reads with a rates[] array, and the output is the five quantiles in percent per trophy id. Rewriting the forecaster against that.
